from.slates: OddsPapi (16 games pulled, median of books)

how.A: Rebuild drive model (ratings, depth-chart QB, missing regulars, dome) + key-number score distribution (margin sd 13.4, total sd 13.5)
how.B: Sharp-weighted devigged market number; look-ahead lines (kickoff 4+ days out) trust about a third of a spread gap, later lines none; slate total guard. NFL game tiers max B (lean) until live tracking proves them; player props carry the tier A bets.

props.A: 5%+ EV (ours and blended) on an UNDER, or on receptions either side
props.B: 5%+ EV on an over of another stat (opener 53.5% / +1.9%, close 43% / -16%): lean, tracked
props.C: pass attempts, rushing yards and carries (lost at 5%+ EV at open and close)

tested.caveat: two weeks of games (Oct 16-26 2026), bets share games
